name: recovered_fixed_test_20261120
training_policy: No training, epoch selection, ensemble, blending or scaling fit. Evaluate exactly the six saved seed42 checkpoints shown in the screenshot; keep their original pre-2018 scalers and target scales.
comparison_policy: All six use exactly the same origin/target pairs per horizon. Compare known published Brent spot and known Brent futures close. Do not select or modify a model using these results.
target_policy: Both origin and destination in test; horizons count Monday-Friday including holidays; use actual published Brent target as of the exclusive test end, never fill missing target prices.
interval_policy: Symmetric empirical 80% absolute-residual quantile from the saved 2018-2022 validation forecasts of each checkpoint; fixed before this evaluation, without a coverage guarantee because validation selected epochs and targets overlap.
regime_policy: Origin-only 21-weekday known Brent log-change volatility, with 90th percentile threshold estimated before 2018; no exclusions based on realized errors or later events.
prior_period_evaluation: The 2023-2024 block was already evaluated for another model pipeline. This execution compares the six recovered frozen checkpoints on that same historical block; it is not the first use of that block.
